correctness.rationale: The source matrix is multiplication by a bounded-degree polynomial on the \(m\)-dimensional polynomial space. Cancelling a monic gcd reduces intersections to \(au=bv\) with coprime \(a,b\), forcing \(u=bh\) and \(v=ah\) and giving dimension \(\max(0,m-t)\). Unique monic gcd decomposition gives the exact ordered pair counts. Finite replay over \(q\in\{3,5,9\}\) matches all ranks, intersections, \(t\)-strata, and distances.
